fix.name: Achintya
fix.meaning_en: Inconceivable, beyond thought; a name of Shiva.
Relating to Agni; a name of Skanda (Kartikeya).

fix.name: Agnivesha
fix.meaning_en: Name of an ancient sage and physician, a disciple of Atreya (uncertain detail).

fix.name: Agrasen
fix.meaning_en: Having a foremost army; name of a renowned king.

fix.name: Akrura
fix.meaning_en: Not cruel, gentle; the devout uncle of Krishna.

fix.name: Ambarisha
fix.meaning_en: Name of a king renowned as a devotee of Vishnu.

fix.name: Anshuman
fix.meaning_en: Radiant, full of rays; name of an ancestor of Bhagiratha.

fix.name: Angiras
fix.meaning_en: Name of a great ancient sage (ṛṣi).

fix.name: Animesh
fix.meaning_en: Unblinking, ever-watchful; a name of Vishnu.
